segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Good morning, Mr. Tan. I’m Dr. Lim from the anesthesia team. Today, we’ll discuss your upcoming surgery to ensure everything goes smoothly. Can you tell me about your current condition?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Morning, Doctor. I’ve been having pain in my tummy, especially after eating. The scans showed gallstones, so they decided to remove the gallbladder laparoscopically. It’s been bothering me for months lah.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Thank you. Let’s go through your medications. What are you currently taking?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: I take Amlodipine 10 mg every day for blood pressure, Atorvastatin 20 mg for cholesterol, and Omeprazole 20 mg for my acid reflux. Oh, and I stopped Lisinopril last week as instructed.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Understood. Any allergies we should know about?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Yes, I’m allergic to penicillin. Had a bad rash from it once.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Do you have any other allergies, particularly to sulfa-containing medications?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Oh, right! I also can’t take sulfa drugs. Took one for a infection before and broke out in hives. Forgot to mention that earlier.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Thank you for clarifying. Have you eaten or drunk anything since midnight?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: No, Doctor. I stopped eating after 8 PM last night as instructed. Just sipped some water for my morning meds.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Good. Have you had anesthesia before? Any reactions to it?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: No, this is my first time. I’ve only had local anesthesia for minor things before.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Alright. How’s your overall energy and activity level? Can you walk or climb stairs without difficulty?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: I’m pretty active, Doctor. I walk daily and can climb stairs without problems. The pain from the gallstones is the main issue now.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Excellent. We’ll proceed with general anesthesia and intubation as planned. I’ll note your allergies and medication changes. Any questions for me?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: No, Doctor. I think that’s all. Thank you for explaining everything.
